const patch = "*** Begin Patch

+"""Observation-driven controller for the RoboCasa365 CloseOven episode.
+
+This file intentionally uses only the standard robot client: calibrated camera
+images/depth and the robot's proprioceptive state. It has an ``inspect`` mode
+for a free observation and a ``move`` mode for a bounded joint-position chunk.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+
+
+def connect():
+    r = Robot()
+    return r, r.spec()
+
+
+def inspect(tag="obs"):
+    r, spec = connect()
+    cams = list(spec["cameras"])
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="none")
+    d = OUT / tag
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, im in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(d / f"{cam}.png")
+    for cam, depth in obs.depth.items():
+        np.save(d / f"{cam}_depth.npy", depth)
+    (d / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps({
+        "spec": spec,
+        "meta": obs.meta,
+    }, indent=2, default=lambda x: x.tolist() if hasattr(x, "tolist") else str(x)))
+    print(json.dumps({"spec": spec, "meta": obs.meta}, indent=2, default=str))
+
+
+def move(targets, steps=20, tag="move", grip=None):
+    """Run a short settled joint-position move; targets are joint-name values."""
+    r, spec = connect()
+    p = obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_eye_in_hand"], video="none")
+    layout = p.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
+    now = np.asarray(p.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+    pos = np.array([now[layout.index(f"arm_joint{i}")] for i in range(1, 8)])
+    action = np.zeros(13, dtype=np.float64)
+    action[:7] = pos
+    limits = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]
+    for i, v in enumerate(pos):
+        action[i] = v
+    for name, value in targets.items():
+        i = int(name.removeprefix("arm_joint")) - 1
+        action[i] = float(value)
+    if grip is None:
+        grip = float(now[layout.index("grip")]) if "grip" in layout else 1.0
+    action[7] = grip
+    action[8:11] = 0.0
+    action[11] = 0.0
+    action[12] = -1.0
+    action[:7] = np.clip(action[:7], limits["lower"], limits["upper"])
+    actions = np.repeat(action[None, :], int(steps), axis=0)
+    res = r.submit("joint_position", actions, interpolate="linear",
+                   cameras=["robot0_agentview_center", "robot0_eye_in_hand"],
+                   video="none", note=tag)
+    for cam, im in res.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(im).save(OUT / f"{tag}_{cam}.png")
+    (OUT / f"{tag}_meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2, default=str))
+    print(json.dumps({"result": res.meta, "layout": layout, "proprio": p.meta["proprio"],
+                      "action": action.tolist(), "limits": limits}, indent=2, default=str))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2 or sys.argv[1] == "inspect":
+        inspect(sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "obs0")
+    else:
+        move(json.loads(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 20,
+             sys.argv[4] if len(sys.argv) > 4 else "move", float(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else None)
*** End Patch";
